estimates_and_inferences.innovation_lens: Treat concentrated frontier-customer adoption and aggressive reinvestment as potentially positive early-category signals, analogous to early platform winners, but do not waive hard-veto discipline.
estimates_and_inferences.category_thesis: Astera is attempting to move from retimer supplier to rack-scale AI connectivity platform spanning signal conditioning, memory connectivity, scale-up/PCIe switching and observability software.
estimates_and_inferences.key_bottleneck_thesis: As accelerator compute scales, data movement, memory semantics, switching, telemetry and interoperability become increasing fractions of rack value and performance.
